mapper.select: SELECT sys_menu.id, sys_menu.name, sys_menu.en_name, sys_menu.permission, sys_menu.path, sys_menu.parent_id, sys_menu.icon, sys_menu.sn, sys_menu.keep_alive, sys_menu.type, sys_menu.create_time, sys_menu.update_time, sys_menu.del_flag, sys_menu.embedded, sys_menu.visible FROM sys_menu LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu ON sys_menu.id = sys_role_menu.menu_id WHERE sys_role_menu.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY sys_menu.sn DESC
